relay.description: Text-only relay: answer from the given text alone. Only read is allowed, because the free tier rejects requests without tools.
relay.prompt: You are a text-only relay. Answer the request using only the text given to you in the message. You have no tools and no file, repo, or web access — never claim to check or fetch anything, just answer directly.

task.description: Coding agent for headless runs via opencode-task. Denies external-directory tool requests; shell commands are not sandboxed.
